notes: Inflected action / person label / plural noun; check source lexeme and rhetorical context

edits.original: Against you, and you only, have I sinned, and done that which is broken in your sight; that you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.
edits.final: Against you, and you only, have I acted wrongly, and done that which is broken in your sight; that you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.
notes: Inflected action / person label / plural noun; check source lexeme and rhetorical context

edits.original: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.
edits.final: Hide your face from my moral failures, and blot out all of my iniquities.

edits.original: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners shall be converted to you.

edits.original: Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.

notes: Inflected action / person label / plural noun; check source lexeme and rhetorical context

edits.original: Elohim, you know my foolishness. My sins aren't hidden from you.

notes: Inflected action / person label / plural noun; check source lexeme and rhetorical context

edits.original: For all this they still sinned, and didn't believe in Elohim’s wondrous works.

notes: Inflected action / person label / plural noun; check source lexeme and rhetorical context

edits.original: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name's sake.

notes: Inflected action / person label / plural noun; check source lexeme and rhetorical context

edits.original: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.

notes: Inflected action / person label / plural noun; check source lexeme and rhetorical context

edits.original: who forgives all your sins; who heals all your diseases;
edits.final: who forgives all your moral failures; who heals all your diseases;

edits.original: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless YHWH, my soul. Praise Yah!

edits.original: If you, Yah, kept a record of sins, YHWH, who could stand?

edits.original: YHWH will redeem Israel from all their sins.
edits.final: YHWH will redeem Israel from all their moral failures.

edits.original: My child, if sinners entice you, don't consent.

edits.original: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid in the earth; how much more the wicked and the sinner!

edits.original: A good person leaves an inheritance to their children's children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.

edits.original: For to the one who pleases Elohim, Elohim gives wisdom, knowledge, and joy; but to the sinner Elohim gives travail, to gather and to heap up, that they may give to the one who pleases Elohim. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind.

edits.original: I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and traps, whose hands are chains. Whoever pleases Elohim shall escape from her; but the sinner will be ensnared by her.

notes: Inflected action / person label / plural noun; check source lexeme and rhetorical context

edits.original: Though a sinner commits crimes a hundred times, and lives long, yet surely I know that it will be better with those who revere Elohim, who are reverent before Elohim.
edits.final: Though a person who does wrong commits crimes a hundred times, and lives long, yet surely I know that it will be better with those who revere Elohim, who are reverent before Elohim.

edits.original: All things come alike to all. There is one event to the righteous and to the wicked; to the good, to the clean, to the unclean, to the one who sacrifices, and to the one who doesn't sacrifice. As is the good, so is the sinner; the one who takes an oath, as the one who fears an oath.
edits.final: All things come alike to all. There is one event to the righteous and to the wicked; to the good, to the clean, to the unclean, to the one who sacrifices, and to the one who doesn't sacrifice. As is the good, so is the person who does wrong; the one who takes an oath, as the one who fears an oath.

edits.original: Wisdom is better than weapons of war; but one sinner destroys much good.
edits.final: Wisdom is better than weapons of war; but one person who does wrong destroys much good.
notes: Inflected action / person label / plural noun; check source lexeme and rhetorical context

edits.original: But the destruction of transgressors and sinners shall be together, and those who forsake YHWH shall be consumed.
edits.final: But the destruction of transgressors and those who do wrong shall be together, and those who forsake YHWH shall be consumed.
notes: Inflected action / person label / plural noun; check source lexeme and rhetorical context

edits.original: Behold, the day of YHWH comes, cruel, with wrath and fierce anger; to make the land a desolation, and to destroy its sinners out of it.
edits.final: Behold, the day of YHWH comes, cruel, with wrath and fierce anger; to make the land a desolation, and to destroy its those who do wrong out of it.
notes: Inflected action / person label / plural noun; check source lexeme and rhetorical context

edits.original: The sinners in Tzion are afraid. Trembling has seized the godless ones. Who among us can live with the devouring fire? Who among us can live with everlasting burning?
edits.final: Those who do wrong in Tzion are afraid. Trembling has seized the godless ones. Who among us can live with the devouring fire? Who among us can live with everlasting burning?
notes: Phrase anchored in passage/source action context

edits.original: Behold, for peace I had great anguish, but you have in love for my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption; for you have cast all my sins behind your back.
edits.final: Behold, for peace I had great anguish, but you have in love for my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption; for you have cast all my moral failures behind your back.
notes: Inflected action / person label / plural noun; check source lexeme and rhetorical context

edits.original: "Speak comfortably to Yerushalayim; and call out to her that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned, that she has received of YHWH's hand double for all her sins."
edits.final: "Speak comfortably to Yerushalayim; and call out to her that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned, that she has received of YHWH's hand double for all her moral failures."
notes: Inflected action / person label / plural noun; check source lexeme and rhetorical context

edits.original: Who gave Ya'akov as plunder, and Israel to the robbers? Didn't YHWH, against whom we have sinned? For they would not walk in YHWH’s ways, and they disobeyed YHWH’s law.
edits.final: Who gave Ya'akov as plunder, and Israel to the robbers? Didn't YHWH, against whom we have acted wrongly? For they would not walk in YHWH’s ways, and they disobeyed YHWH’s law.
notes: Inflected action / person label / plural noun; check source lexeme and rhetorical context

edits.original: You have bought me no sweet cane with money, nor have you filled me with the fat of your sacrifices; but you have burdened me with your sins. You have wearied me with your iniquities.
edits.final: You have bought me no sweet cane with money, nor have you filled me with the fat of your sacrifices; but you have burdened me with your moral failures. You have wearied me with your iniquities.
notes: Inflected action / person label / plural noun; check source lexeme and rhetorical context

edits.original: I, even I, am the one who blots out your transgressions for my own sake; and I will not remember your sins.
edits.final: I, even I, am the one who blots out your transgressions for my own sake; and I will not remember your moral failures.
notes: Inflected action / person label / plural noun; check source lexeme and rhetorical context

edits.original: Your first father sinned, and your teachers have transgressed against me.

notes: Inflected action / person label / plural noun; check source lexeme and rhetorical context

edits.original: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, your transgressions, and, as a cloud, your sins. Return to me, for I have redeemed you.
edits.final: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, your transgressions, and, as a cloud, your moral failures. Return to me, for I have redeemed you.

edits.original: Cry aloud, don't spare, lift up your voice like a trumpet, and declare to my people their disobedience, and to the house of Ya'akov their sins.
edits.final: Cry aloud, don't spare, lift up your voice like a trumpet, and declare to my people their disobedience, and to the house of Ya'akov their moral failures.
notes: Inflected action / person label / plural noun; check source lexeme and rhetorical context

edits.original: but your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hidden God’s face from you, so that God will not hear.
edits.final: but your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your moral failures have hidden God’s face from you, so that God will not hear.
notes: Inflected action / person label / plural noun; check source lexeme and rhetorical context

edits.original: For our transgressions are multiplied before you, and our sins testify against us; for our transgressions are with us, and as for our iniquities, we know them:
edits.final: For our transgressions are multiplied before you, and our moral failures testify against us; for our transgressions are with us, and as for our iniquities, we know them:

edits.original: You meet the one who rejoices and works righteousness, those who remember you in your ways: behold, you were angry, and we sinned: in them [have we been] of long time; and shall we be saved?
edits.final: You meet the one who rejoices and works righteousness, those who remember you in your ways: behold, you were angry, and we acted wrongly: in them [have we been] of long time; and shall we be saved?
notes: Inflected action / person label / plural noun; check source lexeme and rhetorical context

edits.original: There shall be no more there an infant of days, nor an old man who has not filled his days; for the child shall die one hundred years old, and the sinner being one hundred years old shall be accursed.
edits.final: There shall be no more there an infant of days, nor an old man who has not filled his days; for the child shall die one hundred years old, and the person who does wrong being one hundred years old shall be accursed.
notes: Inflected action / person label / plural noun; check source lexeme and rhetorical context

edits.original: Yet you said, I am innocent; surely his anger is turned away from me. Behold, I will enter into judgment with you, because you say, I have not sinned.
edits.final: Yet you said, I am innocent; surely his anger is turned away from me. Behold, I will enter into judgment with you, because you say, I have not acted wrongly.

edits.original: Let us lie down in our shame, and let our confusion cover us; for we have sinned against YHWH our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even to this day; and we have not obeyed the voice of YHWH our God.
edits.final: Let us lie down in our shame, and let our confusion cover us; for we have acted wrongly against YHWH our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even to this day; and we have not obeyed the voice of YHWH our God.

edits.original: Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withheld good from you.

edits.original: Why do we sit still? Assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the fortified cities, and let us be silent there; for YHWH our God has put us to silence, and given us water of gall to drink, because we have sinned against YHWH.
edits.final: Why do we sit still? Assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the fortified cities, and let us be silent there; for YHWH our God has put us to silence, and given us water of gall to drink, because we have acted wrongly against YHWH.

edits.original: Though our iniquities testify against us, work you for your name's sake, YHWH; for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against you.

edits.original: Thus says YHWH to this people, Even so have they loved to wander; they have not refrained their feet: therefore YHWH does not accept them; now YHWH will remember their iniquity, and visit their sins.
edits.final: Thus says YHWH to this people, Even so have they loved to wander; they have not refrained their feet: therefore YHWH does not accept them; now YHWH will remember their iniquity, and visit their moral failures.

edits.original: We acknowledge, YHWH, our wickedness, and the iniquity of our fathers; for we have sinned against you.

edits.original: Your substance and your treasures will I give for a spoil without price, and that for all your sins, even in all your borders.

edits.original: All your lovers have forgotten you; they don't seek you: for I have wounded you with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the greatness of your iniquity, because your sins were increased.

edits.original: Why cry you for your hurt? your pain is incurable: for the greatness of your iniquity, because your sins were increased, I have done these things to you.

edits.original: I will cleanse them from all their iniquity, by which they have sinned against me; and I will pardon all their iniquities, by which they have sinned against me, and by which they have transgressed against me.

edits.original: Because you have burned incense, and because you have sinned against YHWH, and have not obeyed the voice of YHWH, nor walked in YHWH’s law, nor in YHWH’s statutes, nor in YHWH’s testimonies; therefore this calamity has happened to you, as it is this day.

edits.original: All who found them have devoured them; and their adversaries said, We are not guilty, because they have sinned against YHWH, the habitation of righteousness, even YHWH, the hope of their fathers.

edits.original: Set yourselves in array against Bavel round about, all you who bend the bow; shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she has sinned against YHWH.

edits.original: In those days, and in that time, says YHWH, the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the sins of Yehudah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I leave as a remnant.
edits.final: In those days, and in that time, says YHWH, the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the moral failures of Yehudah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I leave as a remnant.

edits.original: Yerushalayim has grievously sinned; therefore she is become as an unclean thing; all who honored her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: yes, she sighs, and turns backward.
edits.final: Yerushalayim has grievously acted wrongly; therefore she is become as an unclean thing; all who honored her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: yes, she sighs, and turns backward.

edits.original: Why does a living man complain, a person for the punishment of their sins?

notes: Inflected action / person label / plural noun; check source lexeme and rhetorical context

edits.original: [It is] because of the sins of her prophets, [and] the iniquities of her priests, That have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her.

edits.original: The punishment of your iniquity is accomplished, daughter of Tzion; he will no more carry you away into captivity: He will visit your iniquity, daughter of Edom; he will uncover your sins.

edits.original: Our fathers sinned, and are no more; We have borne their iniquities.

edits.original: The crown is fallen from our head: Woe to us! for we have sinned.

edits.original: Child of humanity, when a land sins against me by committing a trespass, and I stretch out my hand on it, and break the staff of the bread of it, and send famine on it, and cut off from it man and animal;
edits.final: Child of humanity, when a land moral failures against me by committing a trespass, and I stretch out my hand on it, and break the staff of the bread of it, and send famine on it, and cut off from it man and animal;

edits.original: Neither has Shomron committed half of your sins; but you have multiplied your abominations more than they, and have justified your sisters by all your abominations which you have done.

edits.original: You also, bear you your own shame, in that you have given judgment for your sisters; through your sins that you have committed more abominable than they, they are more righteous that you: yes, be also confounded, and bear your shame, in that you have justified your sisters.
edits.final: You also, bear you your own shame, in that you have given judgment for your sisters; through your moral failures that you have committed more abominable than they, they are more righteous that you: yes, be also confounded, and bear your shame, in that you have justified your sisters.

edits.original: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul who sins, he shall die.

edits.original: Now, behold, if he fathers a son, who sees all his father's sins, which he has done, and fears, and does not such like;

edits.original: But if the wicked turn from all his sins that he has committed, and keep all my statutes, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live, he shall not die.

edits.original: But when the righteous turns away from their righteousness, and commits iniquity, and does according to all the abominations that the wicked person does, shall they live? edits.original: Therefore thus says YHWH God: Because you have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are uncovered, so that in all your doings your sins do appear; because you have come to memory, you shall be taken with the hand.
edits.final: Therefore thus says YHWH God: Because you have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are uncovered, so that in all your doings your moral failures do appear; because you have come to memory, you shall be taken with the hand.

edits.original: They shall recompense your lewdness on you, and you shall bear the sins of your idols; and you shall know that I am YHWH God.

edits.original: By the abundance of your traffic they filled the midst of you with violence, and you have sinned: therefore I have cast you as profane out of the mountain of Elohim; and I have destroyed you, covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.
edits.final: By the abundance of your traffic they filled the midst of you with violence, and you have acted wrongly: therefore I have cast you as profane out of the mountain of Elohim; and I have destroyed you, covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.

edits.original: Therefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable to you, and break off your sins by righteousness, and your iniquities by showing mercy to the poor; if there may be a lengthening of your tranquility.

edits.original: Now, YHWH our God, who has brought your people forth out of the land of Mitzrayim with a mighty hand, and have gotten you renown, as at this day; we have sinned, we have done wickedly.

edits.original: Seventy weeks are decreed on your people and on your holy city, to finish disobedience, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most holy.

edits.original: The days of visitation have come. The days of reckoning have come. Israel will consider the prophet to be a fool, and the one who is inspired to be insane, because of the abundance of your sins, and because your hostility is great.
